name: flova-tutorial-assistant
palette_policy: default neutral black with localized blurred colored glow; preserve source colors and explicit user choices; no dark-green overall cast
background_motion_policy: author slow deterministic drift, expansion or breathing on a separate rear glow layer; a solid init fill does not generate this animation
boundary_review_policy: inspect native source edges before packaging, then media fit, masks, projected corners, critical content and occlusion across the full motion; technical QA does not certify semantic completeness
camera_policy: default to pronounced 3D camera travel, visible depth/parallax and independent material actions; stabilize for reading and real result playback
screenshot_motion_policy: author camera attention routing, target-bound dynamic highlights and independent card/window motion; static boxes or whole-frame micro-zoom do not suffice
motion_review_policy: required pre-export anti-PPT review of camera, material action, screenshot highlight, continuity, depth and real-product readability, with actual playback/frame evidence
recording_policy: real product use is the core; prioritize recording packaging, then screenshots, and only then focused UI demonstrations
ui_reconstruction_policy: only for a specific value point or a concise core interaction such as long typing; optionally overlay a context-matched blurred recording, then return to real operation or results
